entities.name: The Bog
entities.description: Perfectly circular black pool in the woods of the Kessig Approaches on Innistrad, feared by the forest's terrors and home to an ancient entity.

entities.name: Kessig Approaches
entities.description: Forest region of Innistrad where the Bog lies.

entities.name: Entity of the Bog
entities.description: Terrible, vast, ancient entity living in the Bog that tied the villagers' souls to it.

entities.name: Prioress Merlinde
entities.description: Church of Avacyn prioress sent to teach the people of the Approaches the correct path of faith.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Church that sent Merlinde to the Approaches.

entities.name: Priory of the Nameless Angel
entities.description: Priory built by Merlinde to convert the people.

entities.name: Tacenda Verlasen
entities.description: Sister of Willia, born with powers, who made people follow the Bog again.

entities.name: Willia Verlasen
entities.description: Sister of Tacenda, converted by Merlinde at about fourteen.

events.summary: The Entity of the Bog resides there for centuries, tying the villagers' souls to it.
events.quote: It seeped into the souls of the villagers and tied them to it.

events.summary: Merlinde arrives, looks into the Bog and finds something terrible, vast and ancient.
events.quote: There, she found something terrible, vast, and ancient.

events.summary: Merlinde builds the priory of the Nameless Angel and converts souls to the Angel.
events.quote: they gave themselves to the Angel instead of the Bog

events.summary: Tacenda and Willia are born and manifest powers, turning the people back to the Bog.
events.quote: It made the people follow the Bog again

events.summary: When the girls are about fourteen, Merlinde converts Willia.
events.quote: Merlinde turned the tide around again by converting Willia.

relations.quote: in the woods of the Kessig Approaches on Innistrad
sent to the region by the Church of Avacyn
Tacenda Verlasen and he sister Willia were born

relations.note: she works to convert people away from it
relations.quote: she could not fight it with conventional prayers or wards
